description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential search is for a visionary leader committed to upholding the highest standards of patient care and operational excellence.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. Your leadership will be crucial in driving quality outcomes, optimizing financial performance, and enhancing community relations.This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact within a well-established organization. We are seeking a proactive and compassionate administrator ready to embrace a challenging yet rewarding position.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Demonstrated success in operational management, financial oversight, and regulatory compliance.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Commitment to quality patient care and staff development.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000, based on experience.
